_comment: Circle -> canonical state, used ONLY for backfilling rows whose statename is NA (state_source='inferred_circle'). A circle is listed here ONLY if it is genuinely single-state in the source data. Multi-state circles (North Eastern, West Bengal, Maharashtra, Tamilnadu, Kerala, Punjab, Jammu Kashmir, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, etc.) are intentionally EXCLUDED per project policy, even when one state dominates, because using them would guess wrong for the minority rows. Keys are matched after uppercasing and collapsing whitespace.
